note: SPEC-18 proposal §4.4: a read in rounds equals the same read over the whole surface. See vectors/store/README.md §5.

cases.name: the-whole-garden
cases.note: Four rounds. plant:s is reached three ways and cutting:1 twice; seed:1 only through the garden's own link to plant:s. g-features-c1 is fetched in round 1 and files at cutting:1 in round 3. c2-tag-neg-at-b1 is fetched in round 2 and its target in round 3.

cases.name: an-expand-at-the-root
cases.note: The same tree written as a bare expand: the root is the only first anchor.

cases.name: a-fixed-entity-read-at-another-root
cases.note: The first round asks for the fix entity and the request root together.

cases.name: signed-time-cuts-a-link-and-a-strike
cases.note: b1-late-note (t=90), p1-has-c3 (t=80) and g-features-c1-neg-neg (t=70) fail timestampAtMost. cutting:3 is never an anchor, and the featured link is struck at the garden and at cutting:1. b1-late-note-neg-at-c2 (t=57) passes while its target does not: it is no member through bed:1, and a member, struck, through cutting:2.

cases.name: arrival-cuts-a-strike-so-a-child-appears
cases.note: b2-has-p2-neg arrives after the cut, so plant:2 is a child and an anchor. c2-tag-neg-neg arrives after the cut too, so c2-tag is struck.

cases.name: an-excluded-id-ends-a-chain-at-its-start
cases.note: c2-size-n1 is excluded: c2-size stands, and n2 and n3 are not members.

cases.name: an-excluded-id-in-the-middle-of-a-chain
cases.note: c2-size-n2 is excluded: n1 stands and strikes c2-size, and n3 is not a member.

cases.name: an-excluded-link-leaves-the-other-paths
cases.note: g-has-ps and b1-has-ps are excluded. plant:s is still a child of bed:2, one level deeper, so seed:1 is out of reach.

cases.name: an-excluded-negation-held-before-its-target
cases.note: c2-tag-neg-at-b1 is excluded. Round 2 would fetch it at bed:1; c2-tag-neg-neg hangs from it and is not a member.

cases.name: every-field
cases.note: All three fields select at once.

cases.name: lawful-strikers
cases.note: The mask reads the grants entity, a static anchor of round 1. Carol's strike of c1-note is inert; Bob's strikes bind.

cases.name: lawful-strikers-as-of-the-first-admission
cases.note: Only the first admission is admitted. grant-bob (arrival 14) is in it. plant:2 is a child, because the strike of its link arrives later; so is the strike of c2-tag-neg-at-b1, which therefore shows at bed:1.

cases.name: a-hole-bound-by-the-request
cases.note: The request binds the hole, so plant:s is a static anchor beside the root.

cases.name: a-resolved-tree
cases.note: A resolve over the gather: the rounds run on the gather, and the result is a View.

interleaved.name: an-append-after-the-first-round
interleaved.note: late-g-note points at the root, already fetched; late-seed1-note and late-c1-height-neg point below it. A read that keeps going on the later state shows the two deep arrivals without the root one: neither answer.

interleaved.name: an-append-after-the-third-round
interleaved.note: Only seed:1 is still to fetch. A read that keeps going shows late-seed1-note alone.

interleaved.name: an-append-after-the-last-round
interleaved.note: The read has made its last store call. It answers `before`.
